answer: Each identity runs a river-data kernel selling flow readings. It must reach 12 distinct buyers in 4 river basins each epoch, each sale logged with a violet receipt. Auditors tally violet receipts per basin; a self-dealing cluster fails the diversity floor, burning its 70-credit bond. The k-th fake costs 108+4(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 2,106,000, 70,000 locked. A mirror-buyer ring fails once flagged; both sides burn. An honest kernel pays 108 once.
